//: One source of truth for the per-plugin CI lanes. Read by integrations/tooling/lanes.mjs, which .github/workflows/ci.yml and integrations/tooling/run-lane.mjs both go through. See integrations/PARALLEL_LANES.md.

canonicalPorts.//: The ports the shared atomic-server build bakes into its frontend (VITE_PLUGIN_CATALOG_URL / VITE_INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL), so they cannot be changed without rebuilding. Every CI lane uses these — each matrix job is its own runner, so there is nothing to clash with. Locally only the e2e tier needs them, behind a lock. Removing this whole block is the point of integrations/HANDOFF-runtime-urls.md.

lanes.note: No lane job: money has no package.json-less suite and no server-dependent tier. certify.mjs discovers it (it has an atomicCertification block) and the unsharded certification step covers its typecheck, bundle and fixture tests. The entry exists so the lanes-cover-every-directory check passes and so the index stays reserved.
